steps.title: Sketch the base
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as fork_bracket.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane (the ground). Two Point Rectangle 72 x 44 from the origin.

steps.title: Sketch the lug
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the front face of the base. Draw the lug outline: the bottom edge 72 long, vertical ends 18 high, a 36 diameter circle centred 36 along and 54 up, and two lines from the tops of the ends Tangent to the circle.
Trim the inside of the circle away. Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Extrude the front lug
actions: Extrude the lug outline 13 mm back into the part, Join.

steps.title: Mirror the lug
actions: Mirror: the lug feature about the middle plane of the base (22 from the front), so the second lug sits 18 behind it.
steps.note: The sheet gives the lugs as 13, 18 and 13 (44 in all) but the base as 36 wide. The base is made 44 wide here so the lugs stand on it; check this with your tutor.

steps.title: Bore through both bosses
actions: Hole on the front boss face, on the boss centre: Simple Hole, diameter 18, Through All.

steps.title: Relief under the base
actions: Sketch a rectangle 36 x 44 in the middle of the underside. Extrude, Cut, 2 mm deep.
steps.note: The relief means the bracket sits on two pads, so it rocks less on an uneven surface.

steps.title: Holding down holes
actions: Hole on the top of the base between the lugs, 9 from each end (54 apart) and 22 from the front: Simple Hole, diameter 8, Through All.

steps.title: Oil holes
actions: Hole on the top of each boss, on its middle: Simple Hole, diameter 4, To the bore.
